summary: Noah Holdings Private Wealth and Asset Management Limited filed a Next Day Disclosure Return under HKEX rules, disclosing multiple open-market ADS repurchases on the NYSE from December 23, 2025 to January 5, 2026. A total of 137,234 ADSs (representing 686,170 ordinary shares) were bought back at prices ranging from USD 1.975 to USD 2.243 per ADS. These repurchases were executed under a mandate approved at the June 12, 2025 annual general meeting. The shares are held for cancellation, reducing share count over time. This is a return-of-capital event via ongoing buybacks. Watch for future repurchase frequency and potential cancellation impact on EPS.
